# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

**My pick for most people: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**
- It's 0.34" thick and 4.3 oz, with 5,000 mAh and Qi2-certified 15W wireless charging. 9to5Mac's reviewer says it's the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery and runs cooler than competitors.
- It costs $54.99 on Anker's site.
- [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)
- Sources: [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)

**Other good options**

- **Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K).** Android Central found it the thinnest and lightest of the slim banks it tested, at about 0.27" and 104 g. The catch is that wireless charging is only 7.5W, so the Anker is faster. It lists at $52.99 to $69.99. [Android Central review with retailer links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)
- **Slim with more capacity and 25W: INIU SnapGo Air (10K).** It's about 0.5" thick and 195 g, with Qi2.2 25W wireless, 45W wired, and a built-in lanyard-style cable. Android Central lists it at $42.99 to $48.99. Macworld also calls it the equal slimmest 10K MagSafe bank. [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge), [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)
- **10K with 25W wireless: Baseus PicoGo AM52.** It has Qi2.2 25W wireless on iPhone 17 and 45W wired charging. It costs $53.99 with code AM52 (list $59.99). The listing doesn't give thickness or weight, so I can't confirm how slim it is. [Buy via Dealectric (affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w)
- **Rugged 10K: TORRAS MiniMag Pro.** It's 0.57" thick with IP54 dust and water resistance and 15W wireless. It's $69.99 to $79.99. [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**How to choose**
- **Slimness first:** Choose a 5K bank. These usually give about 60–75% of a recharge, according to Macworld.
- **Two full charges:** Choose a 10K bank, which is thicker (0.5" or more).
- **Charging speed:** Only Qi2.2 banks reach 25W, and that works on iPhone 16 and later, including your iPhone 17. Basic Qi2 banks top out at 15W.
- **Cases:** Use a MagSafe/magnetic case. Anker notes that thick or non-magnetic cases can interfere with charging.

I couldn't open retailer pages, so prices come from the search results and may have changed. Check them before you buy.
